# peakhour_reverse_proxy_config (Resource)

Manages Reverse Proxy configuration for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_reverse_proxy_config" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  gzip   = true
  brotli = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `aliases` (List of String) Domain aliases.
- `brotli` (Boolean) Enable Brotli compression.
- `debug` (Boolean) Enable debug mode.
- `gzip` (Boolean) Enable gzip compression.
- `redirect_location` (String) Redirect target URL.
- `redirect_mode` (String) Redirect mode (e.g., 'all', 'http').
- `redirect_status_code` (Number) HTTP status code for redirects (301, 302, 307, 308).
- `segment` (Boolean) Enable segment analytics.
- `track_sessions` (Boolean) Enable session tracking.
- `websocket` (Boolean) Enable WebSocket support.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Configuration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_reverse_proxy_config.example example.com
```
